faq.q: What is the origin of Dhulfiqar?
faq.a: Dhulfiqar is associated with Arabic. Dhulfiqar is Arabic ذُو الْفِقَار (Dhū al-Fiqār), the name of the sword traditionally attributed to Ali.
Yes — the underlying form ذُو الْفِقَار is Arabic.
Dhulfiqar can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Dhulfiqar should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Dhū al-Fiqār is a compound name, not itself a Quranic personal name.
